desc: Read the input values H, W, the grid F, and the number of queries Q.
For each query $(A, B, Y, C, D, Z)$:
Calculate the direct cost: $|Y - Z| + \text{dist}_{\min(Y, Z)}((A,B), (C,D))$.
Calculate the optimal "bridge" cost by running a modified Dijkstra/BFS from $(A,B)$ to $(C,D)$ where the cost of a path is $\text{length} - 2 \times \min_{\text{path}} F$.
The answer is $\min(\text{direct cost}, \min_{\text{bridge}} (Y + Z - 2 \times \min_{\text{path}} F + \text{length}))$.
Output the results for all queries.
